name: Modbus RTU Diagnostic Toolkit

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pytest unit, protocol, CRC, parser, and GUI offscreen test suite passes completely

support_boundary: Evaluation pre-release digital product. Support covers documented Modbus RTU protocol diagnostics, standard COM serial configuration, and report export. Physical RS-485 bus electrical issues and custom hardware proprietary protocols are out of scope.
known_limitations: Hardware integration with real USB-RS485 adapters and physical slaves requires local UAT with appropriate serial drivers.
Write operations (FC06/FC16) are disabled by default in candidate scan mode to prevent inadvertent device overwrites.
Device identity is only recognized for reviewed JSON profile templates; unprofiled devices return NOT_AVAILABLE without serial fabrication.
Demo simulation mode produces synthetic telemetry labeled SIMULATED for walkthrough purposes only.
Application binaries are unsigned (UNSIGNED Authenticode status) during C3 pre-release staging; Windows SmartScreen warnings are expected until code signing is configured.
